description: CG-iLAO* (*constraint-generation iLAO\**) is iLAO* that does not compute every action at every state. Each state starts with only its cheapest actions *active*, and backups use only those. A change of value marks other actions as candidates. A candidate becomes active when it is cheaper than the current value (a violated *constraint*). A final check over all actions makes the policy ε-consistent like that of iLAO*; use it when states have many actions and most of them are clearly bad.

papers.title: Efficient Constraint Generation for Stochastic Shortest Path Problems

lineage.source: stochastic-search, src/cg_ilao.rs: "CG-iLAO* (Schmalz and Trevizan 2024): iLAO* over a partial SSP whose states hold only the actions constraint generation has found necessary"
